mapper.select: SELECT t.*, u1.username AS create_by_username, u2.username AS assigned_to_username, u3.username AS deal_by_username FROM task t LEFT JOIN user u1 ON t.create_by_id = u1.id LEFT JOIN user u2 ON t.assigned_to_id = u2.id LEFT JOIN user u3 ON t.deal_by_id = u3.id where t.id = #{id};
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{taskId}
